messages.subject: Item parameter history
parts:
Hi Phil,

Is it possible to retrieve the item parameters per iteration from the maximization procedure? It would be useful as a convergence diagnostic.

Best,
Rico

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Item parameter history
parts:
Hi Rico,

Currently no, but in principle there probably should be (this is implicitly tracked when the S-EM estimator is used for computing the information matrix, but not for debugging). At some point I'm probably going to include better debugging information in the package, especially before version 2.0 is reached, mainly because the package has reached a pretty stable code-base. 

Phil
